title: The Impact of Soda Taxes: Pass-Through, Tax Avoidance, and Nutritional Effects
eligible_reason: Single adoption date: only Philadelphia taxed sweetened beverages, effective Jan 1, 2017; treated stores are all in one city and share one start date.
design_notes: Classic two-group DiD on IRI store-week scanner data (Jan 2015 - Sep 2018). Equation (1): y_st = a (Philly_s x AfterTax_t) + gamma_s + delta_t + e_st with store and week fixed effects; unit = store x week (tax-status level aggregates, and product-size / category / chain splits); treated = stores in Philadelphia, controls = stores in surrounding 3-digit zips more than 6 miles from the city limit; first four months after Jan 1, 2017 dropped in main regressions. Equation (2) adds After x store-characteristic interactions (time-varying-by-time controls, subgroup interactions). Two-way clustering by store and week. No staggered timing; other tax cities (Berkeley, Seattle, etc.) are discussed only in the literature review and not estimated.
screener_notes: Not eligible: one adoption date (Jan 1, 2017). Data are IRI retail scanner data (licensed, not redistributable) plus demographic data. No replication package listed in batch file. Screened from article text only.
